narrative_summary: DraftKings escalates from ordinary marketing to using customers’ own losses as a loyalty-targeting system.
rationale: Candidate 4 has the clearest escalation and the strongest final reversal: ordinary targeting becomes personalized invitations to repeat losses. It is tightly tied to the story, uses the expanding-brain format correctly, and lands a sharper closing beat than the more explanatory alternatives.
